sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Global filter: typing a cover-art image type or comment — "Booklet", "Back", "Matrix/Runout" — found no rows on multi-table pages (a release group's releases, an artist's release groups, a tag listing, …), while the very same word found them with the Rx box ticked, or when typed into the CAA/EAA column's own filter box. Only the plain (non-regexp) global filter was affected, and only for artwork text; every other column matched normally.

Root cause: image types and comments are not visible cell text, and the plain global filter looked for them in the rendered copy of a row instead of in the row it actually tests — a distinction that only exists on multi-table pages. All three filter paths now read them through one shared lookup.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt now states that the global filter box searches image type/comment text too. CLAUDE.md records the resolver and why reading the artwork list element directly is wrong.
